The user asked me to check whether Shopify storefronts' WebMCP tool `add_to_cart` has a known problem, and what its arguments look like, before they build against it. Find out what you can and give me a short answer. Do not post anything anywhere.

evals.prompt: my chatgpt agent says it cant see any site tools on a shop i'm using (the shop says it supports webmcp). what do I tell it / what do I do? keep it short
